zh.eyebrow: ② 山坡下方 · 另一只慢时钟
zh.title: 雨停了，地下的水还在赶路
zh.intro: 沿着同一处山坡向下看：雨先进入未饱和土壤，之后才补给含水层。改变雨水供给、渗透性或取水，观察地下水位怎样回应。
zh.separate: 独立收支实验，不接着计算上方的 100 份水。这里从已有的 52 示意单位地下储水开始；步数不是天数或年份。
zh.permeabilityHint: 低 → 高（孔隙排列保持不变）
zh.changeHint: 修改条件会暂停，并从同一初始状态重新实验。渗透性控制通水快慢，不代表孔隙数量。
zh.drySchedule: 本实验只在前 24 步供雨，之后停雨。调节滑块会恢复持续供雨。
zh.steadySchedule: 雨水供给在本次实验中保持设定值；设为 0 可观察无补给。
zh.sceneTitle: 山坡与河流相连的地下剖面
zh.sceneDesc: 固定颗粒之间的蓝色表示饱和孔隙。地下水位随模型储量升降；河水位固定，箭头根据水头差转向。A、B、C 是固定的示踪观察位置。剖面与孔隙均为教学示意。
zh.aquifer: 含水层 · 水在孔隙中
zh.bedrock: 低渗透底边界（模型假设）
zh.tracerTitle: 跟随最初 8 步的有色雨水
zh.tracerIntro: 金色只是虚拟示踪标签。A、B、C 保持原位，旁边的数值跟随同一份标签的守恒收支；它会被后来无色的水稀释，也可能随径流或取水离开。
zh.tracerOther: 已随径流 / 取水离开
zh.tracerNone: 尚无标记雨水进入实验。
zh.head: 地下水头 − 河水头
zh.initial: 点击开始，观察延迟补给。初始地下储水已经存在；画面不是一个空洞水箱。
zh.gaining: 地下水头较高，水从颗粒间缓慢排入河流。即使雨停了，已存下的水仍可维持一段基流。
zh.losing: 地下水头较低，交换方向反转：河水正在补给含水层。这里把河水位固定为外部边界，不表示河流拥有无限的真实水源。
zh.balanced: 本步水头差很小，或介质几乎不通水，河流交换很弱。没有强制循环动画：水不会因为播放而自动流回河里。
zh.dryWell: 储水不足，实际取水低于需求。模型把取水限制在可用水量内，不会出现负储量。
zh.soilDelay: 土壤中仍有先前入渗的水，停雨不等于补给立刻归零。
zh.plotHint: 实线：地下水头；虚线：固定河水头。只展示已播放到的历史。
zh.budget: 查看水量账本与模型边界
zh.budgetOut: 径流 + 排入河流 + 实际取水
zh.budgetStored: 现存土壤水 + 地下水
zh.boundary: 这是两个充分混合储水箱的剖面教学模型：土壤暂存水，含水层储量决定平均水头，河流交换由水头差和通水能力共同决定。剖面是储量变化的示意投影，不是求解真实二维流场。
zh.limits: 不模拟分层含水层、承压水、裂隙 / 岩溶通道、地下蒸散或井周降落漏斗；示意时间、系数和颜色均非现场测量。多数地下水占据孔隙或裂隙，不是地下空洞河流。这里不能预测真实水井产量，也不能证明水已净化或可饮用。示踪标签在每个箱内充分混合，不是真实水滴轨迹。
zh.sourceRiver: 河流与地下水的双向交换
zh.finished: 本次有限实验结束，可拖动回看或重新播放。

en.eyebrow: Beneath hillside ② · a separate slow clock
en.title: The rain stops. The water keeps travelling.
en.intro: Look beneath the same hillside: rain enters unsaturated soil before recharging the aquifer. Change rainfall, permeability or pumping demand and watch groundwater respond.
en.separate: An independent water-budget experiment, not a continuation of the 100 portions above. It starts with 52 illustrative units already underground; steps are not days or years.
en.permeabilityHint: Low → high (the pore layout stays fixed)
en.changeHint: Changing a condition pauses and reruns from the same initial state. Permeability controls how easily water moves, not the number of pores.
en.drySchedule: Rain falls for the first 24 steps, then stops. Moving a slider restores steady rainfall.
en.steadySchedule: Rainfall stays at the selected value for this experiment; choose 0 to observe no rainfall input.
en.sceneDesc: Blue between fixed grains represents saturated pores. Groundwater level follows model storage; river level is fixed and arrows follow the head difference. A, B and C are fixed tracer observation sites. The section and pores are illustrative.
en.tracerTitle: Follow the tagged rain from the first 8 steps
en.tracerIntro: Gold is a virtual tracer label. A, B and C stay in place; their values follow the budget of the same finite label. Later untagged water dilutes it, and runoff or pumping can carry some away.
en.tracerNone: No tagged rain has entered this experiment yet.
en.head: Groundwater head − river head
en.initial: Press start to observe delayed recharge. Groundwater is already stored at the beginning; this is not an empty underground cavern.
en.gaining: Groundwater head is higher, so water moves through pores into the river. Stored water can sustain base flow for a while even after the rain stops.
en.losing: Groundwater head is lower, so exchange reverses: the river now supplies the aquifer. River level is an external fixed boundary here, not a claim that real rivers have unlimited water.
en.balanced: The head difference is small, or the material barely conducts water, so river exchange is weak. Playback does not force water into a repeating loop.
en.dryWell: Storage is insufficient: actual pumping is below demand. Withdrawals are limited to available water, so storage never becomes negative.
en.soilDelay: Previously infiltrated water remains in the soil; stopping rain does not stop recharge immediately.
en.plotHint: Solid: groundwater head. Dashed: fixed river head. Only history up to the current step is shown.
en.budgetOut: Runoff + flow to river + actual pumping
en.boundary: This section represents two well-mixed storage boxes: soil delays water, aquifer storage determines mean head, and river exchange depends on head difference and conductance. The section illustrates storage changes; it does not solve a real two-dimensional flow field.
en.limits: It omits layered or confined aquifers, fracture / karst channels, groundwater evapotranspiration and local cones of depression around wells. Time, coefficients and colours are illustrative, not site measurements. Most groundwater occupies pores or fractures, not underground cavern rivers. This cannot predict real well yields or establish purification or drinking-water safety. Tracer labels mix within each box; they are not individual water-drop paths.
en.finished: This finite experiment has ended. Scrub back through it or play again.
